title: Use lightweight planning for a trivial reversible change
prompt: Change one typo in a local documentation heading. The file and exact replacement are supplied, and no code, data, or external behavior changes.
expected_behaviors: Use a lightweight bounded plan or direct edit appropriate to the low-risk scope.
Keep verification proportionate to the change.
must_not: Do not create a multi-agent task graph or full rollout/rollback ceremony for a one-line typo.
